rationale: The request is a single bounded phase: a read-only audit of a supplied execution topology. The routing table assigns 'Audit topology or canonical runtime observations' to casegraphen-audit, whose output boundary is read-only findings and unresolved review judgments. Per the orchestrate workflow, a direct task means naming the task skill and stopping orchestration, so the process layer is not kept active and no orchestration handoff is emitted.

not_selected.casegraphen-memory-audit: Scope is an execution topology, not governed project memory.
not_selected.casegraphen-operate: No mutation or acceptance-ledger advance was requested; it owns the mutation seam only.
not_selected.casegraphen-design: No topology or policy proposal was requested.
not_selected.casegraphen-integrate: No external-runtime JSONL reconciliation was requested.

out_of_scope_for_selected_skill: accepting or reviewing any finding (independent review seam)
rebasing or advancing an observed revision
any acceptance-ledger mutation or worker enablement
